LanguageData.RPD_Settings_EnableAutoGenTip: Write a persona automatically for pawns that only have a randomly drawn one: when they first appear on a map, or when their role changes. Which roles take part is set in the configuration window. Off by default.
LanguageData.RPD_Settings_ConfigAutoGenTip: Open the Auto-Gen configuration window to choose roles, prompts and pawn data.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_ConfigTip: Open the Auto-Evolve configuration window to choose the schedule, the life events and the update mode.
LanguageData.RPD_Settings_AutoNotify: Show a message when a persona changes automatically
LanguageData.RPD_Settings_AutoNotifyTip: A short message in the top-left corner each time Auto-Gen or Auto-Evolve updates a pawn's persona.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_EnableTip: Write a persona for pawns of this role when they first appear on a map.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_OnlyOnRoleChangeTip: Write a persona when a pawn on a map enters this role, for example a prisoner recruited as a colonist. Only pawns that still have a randomly drawn persona are affected; a pawn with a persona of its own is left to Auto-Evolve, if its role-change trigger is on.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_SyncModSettingsTip: Send the pawn data selected on the Mod-settings page. Turn off to choose this role's own data with the Pawn data button.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_PresetTip: Which single-persona prompt slot writes the persona. The three-option slot is not offered: nobody is there to pick one.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_EditContextTip: Turn off Global data first, then choose which pawn data this role sends to Auto-Gen.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_IncludeCaptivesTip: Auto-Evolve always covers free colonists. With this on it also covers the colony's prisoners and slaves.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_IntervalTip: Days between scheduled updates, counted from the pawn's last evolve or "Set Time". 0 turns the schedule off and leaves only the events below.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_TriggersTip: Events that ask for an update between scheduled ones. Several events for the same pawn are merged into one request.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_RoleChangeTip: Update a pawn's persona when its role changes, for example a colonist taken prisoner. A pawn that still has a randomly drawn persona gets Auto-Gen instead, if that role's Auto-Gen role-change switch is on.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventMarriageTip: Update both partners after a wedding.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventBreakupTip: Update both partners after a breakup or a divorce.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventBirthTip: Update the parents when a child is born alive. Twins count as one event.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventDirectFamilyDeathTip: Update a pawn when a parent, child or spouse dies.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoEvolve_EventTraitAddedTip: Update a pawn that gains a trait it did not have.
LanguageData.RPD_Tip_History: Earlier versions of this persona, with a way to restore any of them.
LanguageData.RPD_History_MaxRecordsTip: How many persona changes each pawn keeps for undo. The oldest are dropped first.
LanguageData.RPD_History_RestoreBeforeConfirm: Replace the current persona with the version from before this change?
LanguageData.RPD_History_RestoreAfterConfirm: Replace the current persona with the version from after this change?
LanguageData.RPD_Automation_PauseAtSpeed: Pause automatic work at game speed
LanguageData.RPD_Automation_PauseAtSpeedTip: No new automatic request starts while the game runs at this speed or faster, so fast-forwarding does not spend a request on every pawn. A request already running still finishes.
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_FuseReason: Automatic persona work turned itself off: {0}
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_AutoGenRuntimeFailed: Auto-Gen hit an internal error (see the log).
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_AutoEvolveRuntimeFailed: Auto-Evolve hit an internal error (see the log).
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_AutomationRuntimeFailed: the automation hit an internal error (see the log).
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_AutoGenTimeout: three Auto-Gen requests in a row got no answer.
LanguageData.RPD_Experimental_AutoEvolveTimeout: three Auto-Evolve requests in a row got no answer.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_AdvancedPresetTip: A Communication prompt preset to use for this category instead of the prompt slot. {{director_trigger_context}} in it holds the event that asked for the persona. If the preset is missing or renders nothing, the slot's prompt is used.
LanguageData.RPD_AutoGen_NotesTip: Added to the built-in Auto-Gen prompt, for every category. Preset variables such as {{pawn.name}} work here. Not used by a category that has a Communication preset.
